betaExitCriteria: Hub boots on physical Waveshare hardware
Touch input passes calibration and navigation test
At least one Rev A Node pairs and remains online for 24 hours
One IR command is learned and replayed 25 consecutive times
One supported fixed-code 433 MHz command is learned and replayed 25 consecutive times
Duplicate command IDs do not cause duplicate execution
Local control works during cloud outage
No critical or high severity open defects
